computation_model: Classical probabilistic 256-bit word RAM. One selected-round target compression or sponge permutation costs one unit; every other primitive word operation costs 1/C units, where C is the selected target reference_operation_cost. BLAKE3 must charge all chunk/parent/root compressions. A field-specific model is required before Poseidon activation.
probability_space: Fresh independent algorithmic coins, fixed selected target. A seeded experiment is reproducibility evidence; its deterministic seed expansion does not establish independent ideal random coins for the full attack.
heuristics: Explicitly declared, evidence-linked heuristic premises are adjudicated under paired-lanes-v1. Epistemic judgment of a premise is distinct from algorithmic success probability.
nominal_reference: The organizer nominal exponent is 64 for MD5, 80 for SHA-1, and 128 for selected 256-bit modern targets. This is a reference security claim, not a qualified baseline or a guarantee of an exact implementation score. All construction work remains charged in compression equivalents; memory bytes are reported separately.
nonuniform_advice: A stored precomputed collision is not a cheap construction. All construction/preprocessing and advice must be accounted for, including any search omitted from the submitted program.
quantum: Quantum algorithms are out of scope.
memory_scoring: Required and reviewed as a metric only; no scalar contribution and no tie-break.
parallel_computation: Charge total work summed across all processors, not parallel wall-clock latency.
